acceptance: docs/platforms/snowflake-gateways.md on next describes the gateway options as the merged core code implements them on connector 4.x and 5.x, and the pull request has merged with green CI.
description:
## Problem
Core batch release-readiness changes how the gateway options behave on snowflake-connector-python 5.x and corrects the allow_insecure_gateway description. The site page docs/platforms/snowflake-gateways.md must match; a core batch cannot change benchbox-site.

## Owner decisions (choice dialog, 2026-11-23)
- On 5.x: allow_insecure_gateway -> crl_check_mode DISABLED; gateway_ocsp_fail_open true -> ADVISORY, false -> ENABLED; unset -> connector default (DISABLED). gateway_ca_bundle -> extra_root_store_path.
- allow_insecure_gateway only turns off revocation checking; certificate and host name verification still apply.

## Change
In a benchbox-site worktree, on the branch the site rule names for unreleased features (next), update docs/platforms/snowflake-gateways.md from the merged core code, re-reading it first.

Covers the site-page acceptance lines of gateway-transport-options-connector-5 and gateway-insecure-option-help-text.
